about: Where each engine in jobs.json runs. Local engines are reached over an SSH forward on Aaron's private Tailscale network; nothing is opened to the internet and no key is stored here. local-big = Blink, its one loaded model (the 4B, on the graphics chip, shared with the chat agents). local-small = GMKtec K15, the 4B model on its processor (20 to 45 seconds), under the name qwen3-4b-16k: the same model file as qwen3:4b-instruct, set to read 16,384 tokens at once instead of 4,096 (2026-11-15), so only this name is used and one copy is loaded. Each PC keeps ONE model loaded: on 2026-11-15 two models on the Blink ran its graphics memory out and crashed it, and the 8B is too slow on the GMKtec (95 to 245 seconds). The two local engines back each other up: if one PC is down or its answer fails the checks, the other runs the job, and only then does it go to claude. claude = a job a Claude session runs by hand; the runner never calls it.
